question: Who among the following was the founder and director of the ‘Darpana Academy of Performing Arts’, an institute that focuses on training students in dance, drama, music and puppetry, in the city of Ahmedabad?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mrinalini Sarabhai**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mrinalini Sarabhai** was the founder and director of the** ‘Darpana Academy of Performing Arts’,** an institute that focuses on training students in dance, drama, music and puppetry, in the city of Ahmedabad.
 
• **Mrinalini Sarabhai and Vikram Sarabhai **founded the **Darpana Academy of Performing Arts in 1949, **situated in Ahmedabad, Gujarat.
 
• Mrinalini Sarabhai, distinguished as an Indian classical dancer, choreographer, and educator, pioneered an innovative approach to dance.
 
• Renowned for her pioneering spirit, she became the first woman to master the traditionally male-dominated Kathakali style.
 
• Recognized for her contributions, she was honored with the** Padma Shri in 1965 and the Padma Bhushan in 1992**.
 
• In 2016, she passed away at the age of 97, leaving behind an enduring legacy.
 
• Mallika Sarabhai, daughter of Mrinalini and Vikram Sarabhai, has diligently led the academy for the past three decades, preserving its rich traditions and fostering artistic excellence.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Amala Shankar **was an eminent Indian dancer, celebrated for her contributions to the world of performing arts.
 
• **Sitara Devi** was a renowned Indian dancer who excelled in the classical Kathak style, in addition to being a skilled singer and actress.
 
• **Padmini Chettur **is a distinguished Indian contemporary dancer, whose artistic journey was shaped under the guidance of the acclaimed dancer-choreographer, Chandralekha.
